scope: Server-owned, human-only, next-round steering in one managed local Game Hub session

contract.voteRule: One replaceable vote per eligible human; repeated identical votes are idempotent.
contract.resolutionRule: The server counts only current human players and applies the stable tie order.
contract.roundRule: A signal targets the next unplayed round, is stored in its Conductor plan and receipt, then rolls forward after completion.

causalPlan.transparentReason: The Conductor kept its receipt-derived RECONNECT identity and appended that BOLD won 1/1 human vote before replacing the exact next-round acts.

transport.sender: The 390x844 P1 controller exposed three named ROOM SIGNAL buttons, selected BOLD with aria-pressed=true, and rendered BOLD LEADS · 1/1 HUMAN VOTE.
transport.receiver: Authoritative /api/state stored votes.p1=bold and exposed the exact applied plan before Round 2 started.
transport.activeRound: Starting Round 2 instantiated the same ordered act kinds and titles in the server-owned live Setlist; shared and phone surfaces rendered HUMAN SPOTLIGHT as Act 1.

persistence.checkpoint: A fresh-process recovery test restored the pending vote and exact BOLD plan from a checkpoint.
persistence.managedRestart: The managed session began from restored Show Memory; Room Signal was added to the restored Round 2 target without rewriting the completed Round 1 receipt.

visual.captureMode: Repeated bounded screenshots and semantic snapshots; no rolling-video capability was available.

automatedChecks.abortRoundIdentity: PASS - reset from active Round 2 returns to Round 2 / seed 12027, not the completed Round 1 identity

boundaries: This proves deterministic human authority and cross-surface transport, not that the three choices are balanced or delightful.
The two user-owned reference archives are not claimed as fully integrated.
